findings.description: The variable `size3` in `main()` is not initialized before being passed to `findIntersection()`
The `intersection` array has a fixed size of 10 elements and no bounds checking mechanism is in place to prevent writing beyond this limit
The `findIntersection` function receives the `intersection` array without knowing its actual capacity
No null pointer validation for the `size3` pointer parameter
